screen.mathmaster.guide.title: MathMaster Guide
screen.mathmaster.guide.introduction.bod: MathMaster brings mathematics quizzes into vanilla bookshelves. Choose a suitable math book, gain intelligence experience, raise your IQ, and earn rewards as you learn.
screen.mathmaster.guide.structure.body: Place a math book in a chiseled bookshelf, then put a regular bookshelf on any of its six adjacent sides. Right-click the regular bookshelf without sneaking to receive a random question.
screen.mathmaster.guide.books.body:
Introductory Handbook: difficulty 1
Elementary Handbook: difficulty 5
Advanced Handbook: difficulty 10
Higher Mathematics: difficulty 20
A Sincere Love for Mathematics: difficulty 30
screen.mathmaster.guide.iq.body: Players begin with a random IQ from 30 to 50, capped at 200. Correct book answers grant XP equal to difficulty, but a difficulty x book cannot advance IQ above 10x+50. Insight XP equals target Intellect multiplied by the correct-answer ratio and cannot advance IQ more than 30 above that target.
screen.mathmaster.guide.rewards.body: Quiz rewards depend on difficulty and IQ, and overlapping tiers may all apply; wrong answers can cause damage, blindness, lightning, or grant Three Cat Milk Powder. An Intellect lead of 1–20, 21–40, 41–60, 61–80, or 81+ increases direct melee damage by 5%, 15%, 25%, 30%, or 40% respectively.
screen.mathmaster.guide.progress.body: A question enters your learning progress after its first correct answer. Recently answered and mastered questions appear less often, keeping practice varied. Each book tracks completion separately.
screen.mathmaster.guide.lingxu.body: Lingxu Ingots come from the highest reward tier and craft the Intellect Mirror and Lingxu tools. The mirror displays IQ and experience. Holding a Lingxu tool grants Flow I and +5 current IQ; holding one in each hand grants Flow II and +10 current IQ. Effective IQ remains capped at 200.
screen.mathmaster.guide.questions.explan: Correctly answered questions reveal their text and answer. Questions not yet answered correctly remain hidden.
